positions.title: .NET Development Bootcamp Student
positions.description: .NET bootcamp student at Tech Elevator.

positions.title: Senior Buyer
positions.description: Planned and presented the rollout of a new forecasting software for the purchasing team called JDA/Blue Yonder. Trained the team and provided support as the superuser. Provided counseling, direction, and mentoring to buyers. Conducted refresh training sessions for the entire purchasing team and coached new buyers. Controlled and streamlined the procurement process for 2 lines of business by analyzing trends.

positions.title: Buyer
positions.description: Managed the procurement process for Tri-anim Health Services' respiratory, anesthesia, and critical care product lines. Ensured inventory was available at the right time in the right place. Exceeded metric goals by proactively managing sales forecasts and demand parameters. Strengthened relationships with vendors to improve communication and performance. Negotiated pricing and surpassed savings goals to source the best products while ensuring the best costs for customers.

positions.title: Associate Buyer
positions.description: Supported the procurement process by maintaining strong relationships with suppliers and obtaining accurate product information. Managed backorders to minimize impact to customers. Analyzed trends and proactively managed sales forecasts in order to exceed fill rate and backorder expectations. Researched and resolved receiving and invoice discrepancies. Supported cross-functional teams in providing information on product availability and supplier performance.

positions.title: Assistant Property Manager
positions.description: Managed two downtown Cleveland, OH residential properties. Assisted to develop, implement, and track the annual operating budget. Reviewed and entered all property invoices while also managing accounts receivable and collection. Managed and implemented building improvements. Supported the team in maintaining high productivity and efficiency. Responsible for executing all Leasing Associate duties.

positions.title: Leasing Associate
positions.description: Executed all leasing duties for two downtown Cleveland, OH residential properties. Responsibilities included responding to prospect inquires, follow-up, marketing and outreach,  resident retention, execution of new leases, and coordinating unit turnover. Duties performed in a professional, timely, efficient, and effective manner with a constant view for the future performance of the team and property. Supported team in maintaining high productivity, maximized efficiency, creative problem solving, and top-notch customer service.

positions.title: Customer Service Representative
positions.description: Responsible for the total operation of a retirement facility branch. Opened accounts for new or returning customers while recognizing customers’ needs and suggesting appropriate bank services. Executed all Teller duties while ensuring compliance with all branch policies and procedures.

positions.title: Bank Teller
positions.description: Provided exceptional levels of service while processing monetary transactions and customer requests. Made appropriate referrals for bank products. Consistently worked to exceed team expectations and sales goals.
